commands.command:
set -eu
git fetch origin work/ux-evolution
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/work/ux-evolution)"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "SOURCE_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo 'HOST_LOAD';uptime
echo 'PNPM_CHECK_START'
pnpm check >/tmp/shelly-ionic-20261011-186-check.log 2>&1 || {
 echo PNPM_CHECK_FAILED
 grep -E 'FAIL|Error|Test Files|Tests |budget' /tmp/shelly-ionic-20261011-186-check.log | tail -90 || true
 tail -95 /tmp/shelly-ionic-20261011-186-check.log
 exit 42
}
echo PNPM_CHECK_PASSED
grep -E 'Test Files|Tests |Performance budget|Performance review|threshold exceeded|budget passed' /tmp/shelly-ionic-20261011-186-check.log | tail -55 || true
echo 'FINAL_TREE';git status --short
echo 'HOST_LOAD_AFTER';uptime
